title: CiscoPacketTracerAgentSkills
description: Tool specifications for autonomous Cisco Packet Tracer UI automation.

tools.name: focus_and_maximize_cpt
tools.description: Locate, activate, and maximize the Cisco Packet Tracer application window.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to search for window

tools.name: deploy_device
tools.description: Deploy a networking device (router, switch, PC) onto the Packet Tracer logical canvas.

target_x.description: Target screen X coordinate on the canvas

target_y.description: Target screen Y coordinate on the canvas

tools.name: connect_devices
tools.description: Connect two placed devices on the canvas using a network cable.

device_1_coords.description: [x, y] coordinates of the first device

device_2_coords.description: [x, y] coordinates of the second device

cable_type.description: Type of cable to use for connection

port_1.description: Port index (integer) or port name (string e.g. 'GigabitEthernet0/0') for device 1

port_2.description: Port index (integer) or port name (string e.g. 'GigabitEthernet0/0') for device 2

tools.name: delete_element
tools.description: Select the delete tool and remove the element at the specified canvas coordinates.

target_x.description: X coordinate of the element to delete

target_y.description: Y coordinate of the element to delete

tools.name: open_cli_tab
tools.description: Open a device configuration window and activate its CLI console tab.

device_x.description: Canvas X coordinate of the device

device_y.description: Canvas Y coordinate of the device

tools.name: execute_ios_commands
tools.description: Sequentially send and execute Cisco IOS CLI commands to the active terminal.

command_list.description: List of IOS commands to execute in sequence

dismiss_initial_dialog.description: Whether to automatically dismiss the initial configuration dialog prompt

tools.name: configure_pc_ip
tools.description: Configure static IP address settings on a PC via its Desktop IP Configuration app.

device_x.description: Canvas X coordinate of the PC

device_y.description: Canvas Y coordinate of the PC

tools.name: run_pc_ping
tools.description: Open PC Command Prompt and execute a ping test against a target IP address.

device_x.description: Canvas X coordinate of the source PC

device_y.description: Canvas Y coordinate of the source PC

ping_count.description: Number of ICMP echo requests to send

tools.name: fast_forward_time
tools.description: Accelerate simulation time to immediately converge network protocols (STP green link lights).

clicks.description: Number of times to click fast forward

tools.name: read_cli_output
tools.description: Extract the current text buffer from the active Cisco CLI terminal.

timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for clipboard response

tools.name: configure_vlan
tools.description: Generate and execute IOS commands to create a VLAN and optionally assign switch interfaces.

interfaces.description: List of interface names to assign to this access VLAN
